# ÆGIR Brugghús
> ÆGIR Brugghús is a family brewery on Grandi in Reykjavík, founded in 2017, with two bars of its own: ÆGIR 101 (Laugavegur 2, Reykjavík) and ÆGIR 220 (Strandgata 90, Hafnarfjörður, taproom and event hall).

## Facts (EN)

### ÆGIR 101
- Address: Laugavegur 2, 101 Reykjavík
- E-mail: aegir101@aegirbrugghus.is
- Opening hours: Mon–Thu 12:00–23:00; Fri–Sat 12:00–01:00; Sun 12:00–23:00
- Page: https://sindrimar02.github.io/aegir-brugghus-preview/101/
- Síða: https://sindrimar02.github.io/aegir-brugghus-preview/is/101/

### ÆGIR BRUGGHÚS
- Address: Eyjarslóð 5, 101 Reykjavík
- E-mail: brugg@aegirbrugghus.is
- Visits: by arrangement
- Page: https://sindrimar02.github.io/aegir-brugghus-preview/brewery/
- Síða: https://sindrimar02.github.io/aegir-brugghus-preview/is/brugghus/

### ÆGIR 220
- Address: Strandgata 90, 220 Hafnarfjörður
- E-mail: aegir220@aegirbrugghus.is
- Opening hours: Mon–Wed closed; Thu 17:00–22:00; Fri–Sat 17:00–00:00; Sun closed
- Hall: 150 seated for dinner, 250 to 300 standing, stage, sound system, projector, dance floor, wheelchair access, licence to serve alcohol until 01:00
- Page: https://sindrimar02.github.io/aegir-brugghus-preview/220/
- Síða: https://sindrimar02.github.io/aegir-brugghus-preview/is/220/

## Notes
- Every beer on tap at ÆGIR 101 and ÆGIR 220 is brewed at ÆGIR Brugghús on Grandi, Reykjavík.
- Tonight's taps and events are shown on the home page and the events page (sample data in the prototype).
- ABV, tasting notes and phone numbers are not published yet.
